title: TCS NQT style · Foundation
description: Numerical, verbal and reasoning ability, the NQT Foundation part. 65 MCQs in 75 minutes. Original practice questions modelled on the publicly reported test pattern. Not an official or past paper.

questions.text: A starts a business with Rs 4000. After 3 months B joins with Rs 9000. At the end of the year the profit is Rs 4300. What is B's share?
What is the area of a circle of radius 3.5 cm? (Use π = 22/7)
A starts a business with Rs 8000. After 4 months B joins with Rs 4000. At the end of the year the profit is Rs 2000. What is B's share?
In how many different ways can the letters of the word COMMITT be arranged?
questions.explanation: 7! divided by the factorials of repeated letters (M:2, T:2) = 1260.

questions.text: 3 bells ring at intervals of 6, 20 and 15 seconds. If they ring together now, after how many seconds will they next ring together?
questions.explanation: LCM(6, 20, 15) = 60 seconds.

questions.text: The price of an item is first increased by 30% and then decreased by 15%. What is the net percentage change in its price?
questions.explanation: Net factor = (1 + 30/100)(1 - 15/100) = 221/200, so the change is 21/2%: a 21/2% increase.

questions.text: Rs 8450 is divided among A, B and C in the ratio 3 : 5 : 5. What is A's share?
The average age of 20 students is 51 years. When the teacher's age is included, the average decreases by 2 years. What is the teacher's age?
questions.explanation: New total = 49 × 21 = 1029; old total = 1020; teacher = 9.

questions.text: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 20 and 15 hours. Pipe C can empty it in 30 hours. If all three are opened together, how long will the tank take to fill?
questions.explanation: Net rate = 1/20 + 1/15 − 1/30 = 1/12 tank/hour, so 12 hours.

questions.text: A can do a job in 30 days and B in 18 days. They work together for 3 days, then B leaves. In how many more days will A finish the job?
questions.explanation: In 3 days they do 4/15 of the work; 11/15 is left, which A does in 11/15 × 30 = 22 days.

questions.text: A sum of money amounts to Rs 19240 in 4 years at 12% per annum simple interest. What is the sum?
A starts a business with Rs 11000. After 8 months B joins with Rs 6000. At the end of the year the profit is Rs 2600. What is B's share?
In how many different ways can the letters of the word SUCCESS be arranged?
questions.explanation: 7! divided by the factorials of repeated letters (S:3, C:2) = 420.

questions.text: A can do a job in 10 days and B in 40 days. They work together for 3 days, then B leaves. In how many more days will A finish the job?
questions.explanation: In 3 days they do 3/8 of the work; 5/8 is left, which A does in 5/8 × 10 = 25/4 days.

questions.text: A bag has 2 red, 3 blue and 5 green balls. Two balls are drawn at random. What is the probability that both are red?
In what ratio must rice at Rs 32/kg be mixed with rice at Rs 54/kg so that the mixture costs Rs 46/kg?
questions.explanation: Alligation: (cheaper : dearer) = (54 − 46) : (46 − 32) = 4:7.

questions.text: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 8 and 24 hours. Pipe C can empty it in 12 hours. If all three are opened together, how long will the tank take to fill?
questions.explanation: Net rate = 1/8 + 1/24 − 1/12 = 1/12 tank/hour, so 12 hours.

questions.text: In how many different ways can the letters of the word BALLOON be arranged?
questions.explanation: 7! divided by the factorials of repeated letters (L:2, O:2) = 1260.

questions.text: In what ratio must rice at Rs 30/kg be mixed with rice at Rs 72/kg so that the mixture costs Rs 32/kg?
questions.explanation: Alligation: (cheaper : dearer) = (72 − 32) : (32 − 30) = 20:1.

questions.text: What is the sum of the first 34 terms of the series 4, 11, 18, ...?

Read the passage and answer.

Teamwork is often judged in interviews through group discussions. Candidates who speak the most do not always do best. Evaluators look for people who listen, build on others' points, bring the group back to the topic and help reach a conclusion. Interrupting others or repeating the same point usually counts against a candidate.

The passage is mainly about
options: how teamwork is judged in group discussions
questions.explanation: The passage supports: how teamwork is judged in group discussions.

questions.explanation: Correct: He was the taller of the two brothers.

questions.text: Choose the best replacement for the part in brackets: She [cannot help to laugh] at his jokes.
questions.explanation: Correct: She cannot help laughing at his jokes.

questions.text:
Read the passage and answer.

A good resume is short and specific. Recruiters spend less than a minute on a first look, so the most important facts must be easy to find. Instead of listing duties, strong resumes show results with numbers, such as ‘reduced page load time by 40%’. Spelling mistakes and long paragraphs create a poor impression.

The word ‘specific’ means
questions.explanation: The passage supports: precise.

questions.text: Fill in the blank: She sings ____ than her sister.
questions.explanation: Correct: She sings better than her sister.

questions.text:

(A) He gave me (B) an advice (C) which proved (D) very useful.
questions.explanation: ‘Advice’ is uncountable: ‘a piece of advice’.

questions.text:
Read the passage and answer.

Many rivers in India are fed by Himalayan glaciers. As temperatures rise, these glaciers are shrinking. In the short term this can increase river flow and the risk of floods; in the long term, rivers may carry less water in dry months. Scientists stress the need to monitor glaciers and to plan water use carefully.

In the short term, shrinking glaciers can
options: increase river flow and flood risk
questions.explanation: The passage supports: increase river flow and flood risk.

questions.text: Which number is the odd one out: 324, 361, 363, 16?
questions.explanation: 363 — all others are perfect squares.

questions.text: What comes next in the series: 10, 17, 26, 37, 50, ?
questions.explanation: Rule: squares of 3, 4, ... plus 1. Next term = 65.

questions.text: What comes next: EV, LO, SH, ZA, ?
questions.explanation: First letters move +7; second letters move −7 from the other end of the alphabet.

questions.text: In a row of 32 students, Kavya is 12th from the left. Dev is 5 places to the right of Kavya. What is Dev's position from the right end?
questions.explanation: Dev is 17th from the left, so 32 − 17 + 1 = 16th from the right.
The rule is n → n³; for 11 it gives 1331.

questions.text: In a certain code, FOREST is written as ENQDRS. How is LADDER written in that code?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted -1 place in the alphabet.
a ⊕ b = a² + b²; so 6 ⊕ 3 = 45.

questions.text: What comes next in the series: 20, 24, 32, 44, 60, ?
questions.explanation: Rule: differences increase by 4 (4, 8, 12, ...). Next term = 80.

questions.text: What comes next in the series: 18, 42, 22, 37, 26, ?
questions.explanation: Rule: two series alternate: +4 on odd positions, −5 on even positions. Next term = 32.

questions.text: A man is facing South. He turns about, then turns left. Which direction is he facing now?
questions.explanation: Right = 90° clockwise, left = 90° anticlockwise, about = 180°. Final direction: West.

questions.text: What comes next: EV, HS, KP, NM, ?
questions.explanation: First letters move +3; second letters move −3 from the other end of the alphabet.

questions.text: What comes next: CX, JQ, QJ, XC, ?
questions.explanation: First letters move +7; second letters move −7 from the other end of the alphabet.

questions.text: A cube painted on all faces is cut into 125 identical small cubes. How many small cubes have exactly two faces painted?
questions.explanation: For an n×n×n cube (n = 5): 3 faces: 8, 2 faces: 12(n−2), 1 face: 6(n−2)², none: (n−2)³ → 36.

questions.text: Gita is taller than Meera. Dev is taller than Gita. Meera is taller than Zoya. Lokesh is taller than Dev. Who is the second tallest?
questions.explanation: Chaining the clues: Lokesh > Dev > Gita > Meera > Zoya. The second tallest is Dev.

questions.text: What comes next in the series: 27, 38, 51, 66, 83, ?
questions.explanation: Rule: squares of 5, 6, ... plus 2. Next term = 102.

questions.text: In a row of 21 students, Nikhil is 12th from the left. Pooja is 9 places to the right of Nikhil. What is Pooja's position from the right end?
questions.explanation: Pooja is 21st from the left, so 21 − 21 + 1 = 1st from the right.

questions.text: In a survey, 29 people read newspaper A, 19 read B, 6 read both and 3 read neither. How many people read only one newspaper?
questions.explanation: Only A = 23, only B = 13; total = 36.

questions.text: Which number is the odd one out: 8, 216, 9, 729?
questions.explanation: 9 — all others are perfect cubes.

questions.text: Ojas's father is the only son of Chitra's father. Chitra is Ojas's ____ if Chitra is female.
questions.explanation: Chitra is a daughter of Ojas's grandfather and not Ojas's mother (his father is the only son), so she is Ojas's aunt.
